services.description: Discover available image models and generate images after confirmation. Tool calls are free; image generation uses normal model billing.
services.name: Drawing

tools.description: Generate images through the same group-aware, quota-billed drawing relay used by the web workbench. The first call always asks for explicit confirmation of the prompt, model, group, image count, and billing impact.

group.description: Optional exact routing group; defaults to image-2 when available

model.description: Optional exact image model; defaults to image-2 or the first available model

tools.name: drawing.generate

tools.description: List the authenticated developer's currently usable image groups and image-capable models. This is read-only and never spends quota.
tools.name: drawing.list_capabilities

services.description: Publish, accept, review, and settle open-source bounties. Tool calls are free; funded rewards and tips use your actual wallet balance.
services.name: Open-source bounties

tools.description: Reserve one funded slot for the authenticated user and record their GitHub handle.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.accept

tools.description: Approve a genuine fix, publish a 1-5 contributor rating, and transfer the escrowed reward. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.approve

tools.description: Cancel a publisher-owned challenge that has no submitted work and release its reward slot. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.cancel

tools.description: Close a published or paused bounty and refund only unused escrow. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.close

tools.description: Create an unpublished bounty draft. Draft creation does not spend balance.

reward_quota.description: Gross listed price for each approved fix before the public platform fee

rules.description: Verification, test, quality, and exclusion rules

tools.name: open_source_bounties.create_draft

tools.description: Permanently delete an unpublished bounty draft. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.delete_draft

tools.description: Get a bounty, its viewer state, mutual ratings, and owner-only participant and ledger details.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.get

tools.description: List the public bounty board in deterministic publication order. The board may be empty and has no default projects.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.list

tools.description: List challenges accepted by the authenticated user, including mutual ratings and reputation aggregates.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.list_accepted

tools.description: List disputes involving the authenticated user. Administrators can list all disputes for third-party review.

limit.description: Maximum cases returned, default 50 and capped at 100

status.description: Optional status: open, resolved_paid, or resolved_denied

tools.name: open_source_bounties.list_disputes

tools.description: List all bounty drafts and published projects owned by the authenticated user.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.list_owned

tools.description: Escalate a bounty disagreement with an evidence snapshot for third-party administrator review. Requires explicit user confirmation.

reason.description: One of merged_but_unpaid, requirements_met_but_rejected, misleading_requirements, abusive_conduct, or other

statement.description: Detailed factual dispute statement for third-party review

tools.name: open_source_bounties.open_dispute

tools.description: Pause a published bounty so it stops accepting new contributors.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.pause

tools.description: Deduct the gross listed price from the authenticated publisher, retain the public platform task fee, and escrow the net contributor rewards. Daily check-in rewards in the same balance can fund the listing. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.publish

tools.description: After approval or rejection, publish a 1-5 rating of the bounty publisher/verifier. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.rate_owner

tools.description: Reject a submission, publish a 1-5 contributor rating, and release its reward slot. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.reject

tools.description: Administrator-only third-party resolution. Can deny a claim or force the escrowed reward payment when evidence proves the work met the bounty requirements. Requires explicit user confirmation.

resolution.description: Public administrator resolution explaining the evidence and decision

tools.name: open_source_bounties.resolve_dispute

tools.description: Resume a paused bounty so it accepts contributors again.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.resume

tools.description: Submit at least one matching GitHub Issue or pull request URL, optionally both, for direct review by the bounty publisher.

issue_url.description: Optional GitHub Issue URL; provide this, pull_request_url, or both

pull_request_url.description: Optional focused GitHub pull request URL; provide this, issue_url, or both

submission_note.description: Optional completion note for direct publisher review

tools.name: open_source_bounties.submit

tools.description: Transfer a discretionary, non-refundable tip from the publisher's own balance to a contributor without reducing escrow. Requires explicit user confirmation.

challenge_id.description: Challenge whose contributor receives the tip

quota.description: Positive tip transferred from the publisher's own balance

tools.name: open_source_bounties.tip

tools.description: Update an unpublished bounty draft. No balance is spent until publication.

reward_quota.description: Gross listed price for each approved fix before the public platform fee

rules.description: Verification, test, quality, and exclusion rules

tools.name: open_source_bounties.update_draft

tools.description: Withdraw the authenticated contributor from an accepted or submitted challenge. Requires explicit user confirmation.
tools.name: open_source_bounties.withdraw

services.description: Read your balance, open the recharge page, and create a transfer link after confirming the exact amount. Tool calls are free; transfers use your actual wallet balance.
services.name: Wallet

tools.description: Read only the authenticated account's available wallet quota. This MCP tool costs zero; transfers and drawing-model usage are separate.
tools.name: wallet.balance

tools.description: Open the official wallet with a bounded whole platform-credit amount prefilled. The user chooses a payment method and confirms there; this is not a payment-provider checkout, successful payment or balance credit. The MCP call is free.

amount.description: Positive whole platform-credit amount, at most 1000000. This only prefills the official wallet; the user must choose and confirm payment there.

tools.name: wallet.topup_link

tools.description: After explicit user confirmation, cancel only your own unclaimed transfer and return the held amount to your wallet. Claimed transfers cannot be cancelled. The MCP tool is free.

transfer_id.description: Identifier of your own pending wallet transfer to cancel and refund.

tools.name: wallet.transfer.cancel

tools.description: After an exact tool grant and explicit user confirmation, hold the specified amount from your wallet and create a private recipient link. Anyone with the link can claim it; share only with the intended recipient. The MCP fee is zero; the held transfer amount is real wallet balance. Reuse only the original market request to retry.

quota.description: Positive integer wallet quota units to hold for the recipient. Inspect wallet.balance for quota_per_platform_credit. The exact amount requires user confirmation.

tools.name: wallet.transfer.create

tools.description: Read up to 50 of your own transfer statuses. Pending links and QR codes are bearer credentials: share only with the intended recipient. Recipient contact details are not returned.

before_id.description: Optional positive cursor; return at most 50 of your own transfers.

tools.name: wallet.transfers.list
